scope: v1.0.0-final concurrency regression plus representative 2.0 period overlay; not product implementation

candidate.bundle_definition: SHA-256 of the sorted relative-path SHA-256 manifest for fixture.sql, overlay.sql, run.sh and state_machine_check.cjs. Generated README/result, container data and stdout are excluded. Product source, migrations and the regression test come only from final_commit/final_tree.

limitations: The overlay is not the formal 0045+ migration or product repository implementation.
Process loss was represented by transaction rollback plus an expired checking lease; no real SIGKILL or database failover was executed.
The overlay command table does not yet persist a request hash, so same-key-different-payload conflict handling remains a Stage 02 requirement.
The overlay stores one statement hash only; the formal contract also requires a separately reproducible source_fact_hash and canonicalization version.
Allocation conservation, multi-month settlements, production-scale lock contention and target capacity remain unverified.
The existing 1.0 Gateway settlement finalizer still needs to enter the formal period lock order during Stage 02 implementation.

followup_implementation_gates: Implement the formal lock order and four-state period contract in the product schema and repositories.
Persist request_hash, source_fact_hash, statement_hash and canonicalization version with immutable permissions.
Verify real process loss, allocation conservation and Gateway/Worker integration in W20-11 through W20-15.
residual_risks: Cross-language canonicalization, multi-period locking and production-scale contention remain implementation/Gate 2 risks, not open P1 findings on this PoC object.
